title: Calixarene-supported rare-earth clusters: heteroatom bridge influences cluster composition

synthesis.procedure: Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (131 mg, 0.3 mmol) and TBHOC[4] (100 mg, 0.15 mmol) were dissolved in a 1:1 v/v mixture of MeOH/dmf (12 ml). After 10 min of stirring, Et3N (0.1 ml) was added and the solution stirred for a further hour. A precipitate formed and was removed by filtration to leave a colourless solution. Colourless crystals of 1 were obtained by vapour diffusion with Et2O.
synthesis.time: stir 10 min, then 1 h after Et3N addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution synthesis followed by vapour diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: precipitate removed by filtration; colourless crystals obtained by vapour diffusion with Et2O

properties.summary: dc χMT of 1 at high T is 39.5 cm3 K mol−1, as expected for five non-interacting Gd3+ ions. χMT declines only slowly down to ~25 K then more steeply, indicating very weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic exchange. An isotropic 1J model (H = −2J Si·Sj) with g fixed at 2.00 fits the data with J = −0.060 cm−1.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: high temperature; applied field 0.1 T; 275–5 K range (Fig. 4)

measurements.name: exchange coupling J (isotropic 1J model)
measurements.conditions: g fixed at 2.00; assumes equivalent Gd···Gd interactions

properties.summary: High-T χMT of 2 is 59.0 cm3 K mol−1, as expected for five non-interacting Tb3+ ions. χMT drops slowly to ~25 K then more steeply, consistent with very weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic exchange. No slow magnetic relaxation: no out-of-phase (χM'') ac signals and no hysteresis in dc M vs H scans.
